note: The outreach pushback on installers (the rustup debate, getplumber/plumber#390): the rustup project's own installer piped into sh, in a test job with contents: read and no secret. The installer can change without a change in this repository, but whoever controls it reaches a job that holds nothing: code execution in the runner, a poisoned cache at worst, High, never Critical. The debian:forky-slim container is a mutable image into the same job, High as well, but only not pinned, so the dependency cap holds it at Medium; the installer is no reference to pin and keeps its High. Hand count: one High path 15, one Medium path 6, no other finding, so 100 - 21 = 79: B.
